7200.title: ACP failures lose request identity
7200.rootCauseOneLine: The ACP request wrapper preserves response code and data but discards outbound method and params; the underlying Cursor access rejection remains unverified.
7200.proposedFix: Define a safe allowlist/redaction contract for ACP request diagnostics, then capture the affected account's sanitized RPC before changing model selection.
7200.caveats: Three diagnostic regressions fail in both trusted clean checkouts. No real Cursor account was used; model entitlement and desktop parity were not reproduced. No source fix or pull request was attempted.
